Jell-O Strawberry Parfait
By: ldh
Published: Wednesday, March 14, 2012 - 7:19pm

Ingredients




1 package (3oz) Jello-o brand gelatin, any flavor
1 cup sliced fresh fruit
1 cup thawed Cool Whip whipped topping

Preparation

1 Prepare gelatin according to package directions. Chill until slightly thickened. Set aside 1/3 cup. Add fruit to remaining gelatin; spoon into 4 to 5 glasses. Chill glasses at an angle until jello is set. See blog post for how-to with photos. 2 Meanwhile, fold whipped topping into measured (1/3 cup) gelatin. Spoon topping mixture into glasses of set jello. Chill. Garnish

About

A dessert that is light and pretty and made with just three ingredients.
Blog post here: http://gratefulprayerthankfulheart.blogspot.com/2012/03/jell-o-strawberry-parfait.html
